title: Deceptive Claims Using Fake News Advertising: The Impact on Consumers
eligible_reason: Single common shutdown date, no staggered adoption, nonlinear (zero-inflated Poisson) estimator and merchant-type-specific trends.
design_notes: Event study around one date: the April 2011 FTC order shutting down ten fake-news-site operators (174 product domains), using comScore browsing data aggregated to domain-year-month. Eq. 5: y_jt = b Post_t + b_FTC Post_t x FTCY + merchant-type FE + merchant-type x 2011 FE + merchant-type-specific monthly trend, comparing a three-month post window in 2011 to the same months in 2010 (placebo date also used). Table 5 estimates a zero-inflated Poisson (nonlinear), with a linear version used only to illustrate. Appendix A adds a difference-in-difference-in-differences with control sites. Entire sample is treated at the same date.
screener_notes: Not eligible: single date, nonlinear model, unit-type trends. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. comScore panel data (licensed).
